decisions.reason: Editable-file reuse does not establish the separately requested modular template system, whose inclusion in the engagement remains unresolved.
Free Canva assets, file ownership, and editing rights do not change the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
The Canva access and reuse terms do not change the required document coverage, layout pass count, or graphic treatment.
Agua Arc branding was already established by message 49; the source Event's Canva ownership and access terms add no branding-state change.
The Canva asset and editing-access decision does not alter the requirement to incorporate supplied photos.
Ownership and independent editing of the Canva file do not change which supplied narrative content must be included.
The source decision does not change inclusion of the budget sheet or supplied proposal tables.
